Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves and fruit.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Apply fungicides like captan, mancozeb or copper-based sprays during bud break.

Apple___Black_rot.hi: सेब का काला सड़ांध रोग (ब्लैक रॉट)
Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Concentric rings on fruit rot, purple/brown spots on leaves (frogeye leaf spot).
Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Prune infected branches and apply thiophanate-methyl or captan.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange spots on the upper leaf surface.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Spray myclobutanil or propiconazole fungicide in early spring.

Apple___healthy.treatment: Maintain regular balanced fertilization and drip irrigation.

Cherry___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal patches on new leaves and shoot tips.
Cherry___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply wettable sulfur or azoxystrobin at early petal fall.

Cherry___healthy.symptoms: Foliage intact with no fungal spots.
Cherry___healthy.treatment: Standard orchard maintenance and balanced nutrient supply.

Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot.symptoms: Rectangular, brown to gray lesions running parallel to leaf veins.
Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot.treatment: Use resistant hybrids; spray azoxystrobin + propiconazole at silking.

Corn___Common_rust.symptoms: Cinnamon-brown pustules scattered across both leaf surfaces.
Corn___Common_rust.treatment: Spray tebuconazole or pyraclostrobin upon early signs.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Crop rotation, resistant seed varieties, and mancozeb spray.

Corn___healthy.symptoms: Lush green blade leaves with no necrotic lesions.
Corn___healthy.treatment: Adequate nitrogen fertilization and pest monitoring.

Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown circular spots on leaves; berries shrivel into black mummies.
Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Apply mancozeb, myclobutanil or boscalid from early shoot stage.

Grape___Esca.symptoms: Tiger-stripe chlorosis and necrosis on leaves; dark spots on fruit skin.
Grape___Esca.treatment: Prune out diseased wood; disinfect pruning shears; apply wound protectants.

Grape___Leaf_blight.symptoms: Irregular dark brown patches on mature foliage leading to defoliation.

Grape___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous green vine canopy without leaf spotting.
Grape___healthy.treatment: Proper shoot positioning, air circulation, and balanced fertigation.

Orange___Haunglongbing.symptoms: Asymmetric blotchy mottling on leaves, yellow shoots, bitter misshapen fruit.
Orange___Haunglongbing.treatment: Control Asian citrus psyllid vector using imidacloprid; remove infected trees.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Water-soaked angular purple-brown spots dropping out (shot-hole effect).
Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper sprays at dormant and shuck split stage; avoid overhead irrigation.

Peach___healthy.symptoms: Clean leaves free from spots or cankers.
Peach___healthy.treatment: Maintain balanced zinc and boron orchard nutritional program.

Pepper___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked blistering lesions turning dark brown with yellow halos.
Pepper___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper hydroxide mixed with mancozeb; use certified disease-free seeds.

Pepper___healthy.treatment: Provide balanced N-P-K, calcium feeding, and regular moisture.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Brown to black spots with concentric rings creating a target-board pattern.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil, mancozeb or difenoconazole spray.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular lesions with white mold on leaf underside in damp weather.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Immediately spray metalaxyl + mancozeb or cymoxanil + mancozeb.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Robust green leaves with no blight spots.
Potato___healthy.treatment: Good hilling up and monitored preventive spray schedule.

Raspberry___healthy.symptoms: No visible signs of infection or necrosis.
Raspberry___healthy.treatment: Mulch root zones and maintain adequate soil moisture.

Soybean___healthy.symptoms: Clean trifoliate leaves with vibrant green coloration.
Soybean___healthy.treatment: Rhizobium inoculation and timely weed management.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White talcum powder-like fungal growth coating upper leaf surfaces.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Spray potassium bicarbonate, neem oil, or hexaconazole.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.symptoms: Irregular purple to brown blotches coalescing to give a scorched appearance.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Remove dead foliage post-harvest; spray captan or thiophanate-methyl.

Strawberry___healthy.symptoms: Healthy green leaves without necrotic lesions.
Strawberry___healthy.treatment: Use clean straw mulching and avoid wet canopy conditions.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small greasy water-soaked circular dark brown spots with halo.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply streptomycin sulfate or copper oxychloride.

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown rings forming target spots on lower mature leaves.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large, dark water-soaked greasy patches rapidly wilting leaves.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Immediate application of cymoxanil + mancozeb or dimethomorph.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale greenish-yellow spots on upper leaf surface, olive-green mold beneath.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Improve greenhouse ventilation and spray copper or difenoconazole.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Numerous small circular spots with grayish-white centers and dark borders.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Prune lower leaves to minimize soil splash; apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb.

Tomato___Spider_mites.symptoms: Yellow stippling on leaves accompanied by fine silken webbing underneath.
Tomato___Spider_mites.treatment: Spray acaricides like spiromesifen, propargite or neem oil.

Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Brown circular lesions with concentric rings and chlorotic halos.
Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Apply azoxystrobin, pyraclostrobin or copper oxychloride.

Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.mr: टोमॅटो पिवळा पाने चुरमुरणे व्हायरस (पिवळा पर्णगुच्छ)
Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.hi: टमाटर का पीला पत्ती कुंचन वायरस
Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Severe stunting, upward curling of leaf margins, bright yellowing.
Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: Control whitefly vector with acetamiprid, thiamethoxam, and yellow sticky traps.

Tomato___Mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green patterns on leaves, puckering and distortion.
Tomato___Mosaic_virus.treatment: Disinfect tools with trisodium phosphate; destroy infected plants; use virus-free seed.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant green leaves without blemish or curl.
Tomato___healthy.treatment: Maintain regular watering and balanced N-P-K nutrient schedule.

pest_classes.description: Small soft-bodied insects feeding on plant sap and secreting sticky honeydew.
pest_classes.control_organic: Spray neem oil 1500 ppm or release ladybird beetles (coccinellids).
pest_classes.control_chemical: Spray imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.5 ml/L or thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.3 g/L.

pest_classes.description: Voracious caterpillar eating whorls and leaving large ragged holes with frass.
pest_classes.control_organic: Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2 g/L or Metarhizium rileyi.
pest_classes.control_chemical: Spray chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.4 ml/L or emamectin benzoate 5 SG @ 0.5 g/L.

pest_classes.description: Larvae boring into buds, flowers, and fruit causing premature drop and rot.
pest_classes.control_organic: Install pheromone traps (5/acre) and spray HaNPV virus.
pest_classes.control_chemical: Apply spinosad 45 SC @ 0.3 ml/L or flubendiamide 39.35 SC @ 0.3 ml/L.

pest_classes.description: Tiny white flying insects on leaf undersides transmitting geminiviruses.
pest_classes.control_organic: Yellow sticky cards (15-20/acre) and 5% neem seed kernel extract (NSKE).
pest_classes.control_chemical: Spray diafenthiuron 50 WP @ 1 g/L or pyriproxyfen 10 EC @ 1.5 ml/L.

pest_classes.description: Slender insects rasping leaf surface causing curling and silvery sheen.
pest_classes.control_organic: Blue sticky traps and verticillium lecanii spray.
pest_classes.control_chemical: Spray fipronil 5 SC @ 1.5 ml/L or spinetoram 11.7 SC @ 0.8 ml/L.

pest_classes.description: Larvae tunneling inside stems leading to dead heart and white earhead.
pest_classes.control_chemical: Apply cartap hydrochloride 4G granules @ 10 kg/acre or chlorantraniliprole.

pest_classes.description: Wedge-shaped insects causing hopper burn, yellowing margins, and curled tips.
pest_classes.control_organic: Spray neem oil 10,000 ppm or Beauveria bassiana.
pest_classes.control_chemical: Spray dinotefuran 20 SG @ 0.4 g/L or flonicamid 50 WG @ 0.3 g/L.

pest_classes.description: Larvae folding leaves with silk threads and feeding internally on chlorophyll.
pest_classes.control_organic: Handpick folded leaves and spray neem cake extract.
pest_classes.control_chemical: Apply indoxacarb 14.5 SC @ 0.5 ml/L or novaluron 10 EC @ 1.5 ml/L.

pest_classes.description: Chewing beetles eating shot-holes in foliage and floral parts.
pest_classes.control_organic: Dust wood ash or diatomaceous earth around crop rows.
pest_classes.control_chemical: Spray cypermethrin 10 EC @ 1 ml/L or malathion 50 EC @ 1.5 ml/L.

pest_classes.description: Microscopic arachnids sucking cell sap and generating fine cobwebs.
pest_classes.control_organic: Overhead water misting to disrupt webbing, sulfur dust 80 WP.
pest_classes.control_chemical: Spray fenpyroximate 5 EC @ 1 ml/L or abamectin 1.9 EC @ 0.5 ml/L.
